[accounts]
active = "readyrule"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "readyrule"
name = "readyrule"
harness = "claude"
auth = "managed"
config_dir = "{dir}/claude-alt"

[[accounts.records]]
id = "makers"
name = "makers"
harness = "claude"
auth = "managed"
config_dir = "{dir}/claude-main"

expect.stderr:
readyrule: login probe refused: Login expired
  makers: login probe refused: login probe refused
pick: no launchable candidate among readyrule, makers: only an account with its own config dir can be pinned to a worker. Register one with `fno config accounts register <id> --config-dir <path>` (a full second login in its own dir) login refused; remedy: CLAUDE_CONFIG_DIR=<config dir> claude /login
